#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Push a branch and open (or adopt) its pull request on GitHub.

Pre-0007 this wrote ``prs/<id>-<slug>/pr.md`` and never touched a remote.  GitHub
now holds every field that record carried — head SHA, CI statuses bound to that
SHA, the review verdict — leaving three jobs it does not do: branch hygiene
(``check_bracket_free`` over ``FORBIDDEN_REF_CHARS`` plus ``git check-ref-format``;
docs/CONTRIBUTING.md:122-124 records that a ``]`` in a generated name once broke
part of the parent's PR automation); refusing an empty diff instead of
manufacturing a placeholder commit to make a PR openable; and create-or-adopt, so
a second run adopts the head's unique open PR and PATCHes only the flags given
(gh_common.py:194-200).  The push is real — hooks run, one ref is written, never
``--all``, never a force.  Fail closed: a git or API failure exits 2 opening
nothing.

    pr_open.py --branch issue-42-pauli --issue 42 --title "feat(Quantum): ..." \
               --body-file /tmp/pr-body.md --label formalization
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
import gh_common  # noqa: E402
from wf_util import (BODY_LIMIT, FORBIDDEN_REF_CHARS, TITLE_LIMIT,  # noqa: E402
                     LayerError, check_bracket_free, default_repo_root, sanitize)


CHECKED_PUSH = Path(__file__).resolve().with_name("checked-push.sh")

#: DESIGN.md:106-107 — ``issue-<id>-<slug>``, optionally ``codex/``-prefixed.
BRANCH_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:(codex|claude)/)?issue-(\d+)-([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)$")

#: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md:61-62 — a closing keyword is what makes the merge close
#: the issue, so the footer is appended only when the body carries none.  GitHub's
#: nine auto-closing keywords, exactly; keep in sync with pr_merge.py CLOSES_RE so
#: every reference this footer honors is one the dependency gate also sees.
CLOSES_RE = re.compile(r"(?i)\b(?:close[sd]?|fix(?:e[sd])?|resolve[sd]?):?\s+#(\d+)")


def git(repo_root: Path, *args: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
    """Run git in *repo_root*; stripped stdout, or ``LayerError`` / ``""``."""
    proc = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo_root), *args],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
    if proc.returncode == 0:
        return proc.stdout.strip()
    if check:
        raise LayerError(f"git {' '.join(args[:3])} failed: "
                         f"{(proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip()[:500]}")
    return ""


def checked_push(repo_root: Path, remote: str, refspec: str) -> None:
    """Run the hook before opening the receive transport, then publish one ref."""
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [str(CHECKED_PUSH), "--repo-root", str(repo_root), remote, refspec],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        detail = "\n".join(part.strip() for part in (proc.stdout, proc.stderr) if part.strip())
        raise LayerError(f"checked push failed ({proc.returncode}): {detail[-2000:]}")


def lint_branch(repo_root: Path, branch: str) -> None:
    """Reject a name, or a branch, that cannot safely become a PR head; the
    ``issue-<id>-<slug>`` convention only warns, since the issue link now
    travels in the body footer while ``agent.sh`` still derives names so."""
    check_bracket_free(branch, "branch name", FORBIDDEN_REF_CHARS)
    git(repo_root, "check-ref-format", "--branch", branch)
    if not git(repo_root, "rev-parse", "--verify", f"refs/heads/{branch}", check=False):
        raise LayerError(f"branch {branch!r} does not exist in {repo_root}; create "
                         "and commit on it before opening a PR")
    match = BRANCH_RE.match(branch)
    if not match or match.group(1) == "claude":
        sys.stderr.write(f"warning: branch {branch!r} is not a current-convention "
                         "'issue-<id>-<slug>' / 'codex/issue-<id>-<slug>' name "
                         "(DESIGN.md:106-107).\n")


def require_diff(repo_root: Path, base: str, branch: str) -> int:
    """Commits ahead of the base; raise when there are none."""
    for ref in (f"refs/remotes/github/{base}", base):
        count = git(repo_root, "rev-list", "--count", f"{ref}..{branch}", check=False)
        if count.isdigit():
            if int(count) == 0:
                raise LayerError(f"{branch} has no commits ahead of {ref}: nothing "
                                 "to review. Commit the work — never open a PR on "
                                 "an empty diff.")
            return int(count)
    raise LayerError(f"cannot resolve base {base!r} locally or as github/{base}")


def pr_create(title: str, head: str, base: str, body: str) -> int:
    """POST one PR; an ambiguous failure adopts, never retries (gh_common.py:216)."""
    try:
        created = gh_common.api("pulls", method="POST", mutation=True,
                                payload={"title": title, "head": head,
                                         "base": base, "body": body})
        return int(created["number"])
    except LayerError:
        adopted = gh_common.pr_for_branch(head)
        if adopted is not None:
            return int(adopted["number"])
        raise


# Descriptive labels only: never inherit scheduling, approval or owner state.
# GitHub remains authoritative for existence; see issues-prs.md section 1.
DESCRIPTIVE_LABELS = frozenset({
    "formalization", "documentation", "infrastructure", "cleanup", "refactor",
    "ci", "proof", "proof-infra", "sorry-elimination", "statement-fix", "mismatch",
    "blueprint", "blueprint-sync", "blueprint-only", "2009.12982",
    "paper-1904.05870", "paper-2001.04383", "qpbt-analysis", "qpbt-test",
    "bug", "enhancement",
})


def publication_labels(issue: int | None, explicit: list[str], existing: dict | None) -> list[str]:
    """Resolve additive labels and reject an unclassified PR before publication."""
    labels = set(explicit)
    if issue:
        labels.update(row["name"] for row in gh_common.issue_view(issue).get("labels", [])
                      if row["name"] in DESCRIPTIVE_LABELS)
    known = set(gh_common.list_labels())
    missing = sorted(labels - known)
    if missing:
        raise LayerError(f"labels not in the repository: {missing} — create them "
                         "on GitHub first or drop them")
    retained = {row["name"] for row in (existing or {}).get("labels", [])}
    if not (labels | retained) & DESCRIPTIVE_LABELS & known:
        raise LayerError("PR needs a descriptive label before publication; pass --label "
                         "with an existing descriptive repository label, or label its --issue")
    return sorted(labels)


def open_pr(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repo_root = args.repo_root.resolve()
    lint_branch(repo_root, args.branch)
    ahead = require_diff(repo_root, args.base, args.branch)

    title = sanitize(args.title, TITLE_LIMIT).strip() if args.title else ""
    if title:
        check_bracket_free(title, "PR title")
    raw = Path(args.body_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if args.body_file else ""
    body = sanitize(raw, BODY_LIMIT)  # untrusted on the way out too: it will be quoted back
    if args.issue and not any(int(n) == args.issue for n in CLOSES_RE.findall(body)):
        body = f"{body.rstrip()}\n\n---\nCloses #{args.issue}\n".lstrip()

    explicit = [n.strip() for chunk in args.label for n in chunk.split(",") if n.strip()]
    labels = publication_labels(args.issue, explicit, gh_common.pr_for_branch(args.branch))
    if args.dry_run:
        sys.stdout.write(f"[dry-run] would push refs/heads/{args.branch} ({ahead} "
                         f"ahead of {args.base}) and open {title!r} {labels}\n")
        return 0

    checked_push(repo_root, "github",
                 f"refs/heads/{args.branch}:refs/heads/{args.branch}")

    existing = gh_common.pr_for_branch(args.branch)
    if existing is not None:
        number = int(existing["number"])
        patch = {"title": title} if title else {}
        if args.body_file:
            patch["body"] = body

### 4.2 Work

The session works in its worktree under its sandbox. The standing rules
injected into every prompt are: read `AGENTS.md` first; treat
`local/protocols/*.md` as normative; start no sub-session except through
external `dispatch.sh`; never review your own diff;
keep runtime state out of the
repository; and put the result, the residual risk and the hand-off in the
final message, which is captured to
`results/telemetry/sessions/<name>.last.md`.

### 4.3 Verify

A session is not finished when the model stops. Before its work is accepted:

1. the validation ladder from `AGENTS.md` has been run (single-file
   `lake env lean` checks, then the `sorry`/`axiom` scan, then `lake build`);
2. the hooks pass — a failing `pre-push` is the local equivalent of a red CI
   and keeps the branch unmerged;
3. for Lean or blueprint changes, a **different** session has reviewed the
   diff (§6);
4. the final message exists and says what was done, what was not, and what the
   next session needs. An empty `<name>.last.md` is reported as a warning by
   `dispatch.sh` and should be treated as an incomplete session.

Verification failures are not silent. A failed codex run is recorded with
`status: failed` and its exit code, and `dispatch.sh` exits with that code —
the same fail-loudly semantics the parent repository adopted after a skipped
review read as green (`pr-review.yml:59-60`: "PR Review must not report
success without a review").

paths = [Path('MIPStarRE.lean'), *Path('MIPStarRE').rglob('*.lean')]
graph = {str(p.with_suffix('')).replace('/', '.'): re.findall(r'"'^import'"\\s+(\\S+)', p.read_text(), re.M) for p in paths}
seen = set()
def visit(m, stack=()):
    if m in stack:
        raise SystemExit('Cycle: ' + ' -> '.join((*stack, m)))
    if m in seen:
        return
    for dep in graph.get(m, []):
        visit(dep, (*stack, m))
    seen.add(m)
visit('MIPStarRE')
print('Local modules in root closure:', len(seen & graph.keys()))
for name in ('Absorption', 'MarginalContraction'):
    m = 'MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Points.' + name
    assert m in seen
    print(m, 'reachable')
print('Point helper modules outside closure:', sorted(m for m in graph if m.startswith('MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Points.') and m not in seen))
print('Root import closure: acyclic')

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$ROOT"
HOOK_ROOT="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
GIT_LOCAL_ENV_VARS="$(git rev-parse --local-env-vars)"

run_without_git_local_env() (
  # Git exports repository-local variables while running hooks.  Several script
  # tests create temporary repositories; keep those tests independent of this
  # checkout.
  unset $GIT_LOCAL_ENV_VARS
  "$@"
)

# A merge commit can be syntactically valid while its index has been reset to
# the first-parent tree.  That failure mode silently discarded clean incoming
# additions on issue-109 and issue-110 (issue #222).  Check the pending index
# before every other gate, including the documented blanket hook bypass: a
# missing incoming path is valid only when the branch deleted a base path.
MERGE_HEAD_PATH="$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)"
if [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking the merge result for silent incoming loss."
  python3 "$HOOK_ROOT/local/bin/merge_loss_guard.py" --repo "$ROOT"
fi

# Scope-control guard (EVOLUTION.md 2026-09-01, the issue-0007 overbuild):
# workflow scaffolding is budgeted at <=1000 changed lines per commit (400 until the owner raised it on 2026-09-05).  This is
# mechanical enforcement — repeated verbal correction of scaffolding bloat did
# not stick, so the budget lives in the hook.  The override env var is granted
# by the OWNER per commit, never self-granted by an agent session.  Runs
# before the ACMR early-exit so deletion-only commits are counted too
# (numstat includes deletions; PR 7 round 3, F8), and before the
# MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS exit so a blanket hook skip cannot launder the
# owner-only budget override.
# A merge that carries main stages already-reviewed content.  A merge head
# contained in github/main measures the budget against MERGE_HEAD; a merge head
# that contains github/main (a parent branch of a stack that already merged
# main; owner decision 2026-09-05) measures it against github/main, so inherited
# main content counts zero while the PR's cumulative workflow diff and any
# side-branch content beyond main still count.  Any other side-branch merge
# stays budgeted against HEAD.
if [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ] &&
    git merge-base --is-ancestor MERGE_HEAD refs/remotes/github/main 2>/dev/null; then
  BUDGET_BASE="$(git rev-parse MERGE_HEAD)"
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: main-history merge; budget measured against MERGE_HEAD."
elif [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ] &&
    git merge-base --is-ancestor refs/remotes/github/main MERGE_HEAD 2>/dev/null; then
  BUDGET_BASE="$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/github/main)"
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: non-main merge carrying github/main; workflow-layer content beyond github/main is budgeted."
else
  BUDGET_BASE=""
  if [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ]; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: non-main merge; workflow-layer merge content is budgeted."
  fi
fi
INFRA_CHANGED="$(git diff --cached --numstat $BUDGET_BASE -- local/ .githooks/ \
  scripts/tests/test_dispatch.py scripts/tests/test_github_workflow.py \
  scripts/tests/test_lake_root.py scripts/tests/test_pre_push_hook.py \
  scripts/tests/test_ready_packets.py scripts/tests/test_merge_loss_guard.py \
  | awk '{added=$1; deleted=$2; if (added != "-") total+=added+deleted} END {print total+0}')"
if [ "${INFRA_CHANGED:-0}" -gt 1000 ] && [ "${MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE:-}" != "1" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: staged workflow-layer change is ${INFRA_CHANGED} lines (budget: 1000)."
  echo "Scope control (local/personas/main.md): the budget is PER EPISODE, not per"
  echo "commit — serial oversized commits are the same violation and show in the"
  echo "telemetry. Shrink the change, or ask the OWNER to authorize this commit"
  echo "with MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE=1 (self-granting it is a protocol breach)."
  exit 1
fi

if [ "${MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS:-}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit hook skipped by MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS=1."
  exit 0
fi

STAGED_FILES="$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR)"
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking staged whitespace."
# Paper mirrors under references/ are byte-faithful captures of external
# arXiv sources (see references/*/README.md); their inherited trailing
# whitespace is part of the fidelity claim and must not be "fixed", so they
# are exempt from the whitespace gate (local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md,
# 2026-08-30).
git diff --cached --check -- ':(exclude)references/'

if printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_FILES" | grep -Eq '^scripts/(.*\.py|tests/.*)$'; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: running scripts/tests unit tests."
  run_without_git_local_env python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'
fi

if printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_FILES" | grep -Eq \
  '^(blueprint/src/.*\.(tex|sty|cls)|scripts/(check_blueprint_latex|tex_utils)\.py|scripts/tests/test_check_blueprint_latex\.py|\.githooks/pre-commit)$'; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking blueprint LaTeX conventions."
  python3 scripts/check_blueprint_latex.py --root blueprint/src
fi

if ! printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_FILES" | grep -Eq \
  '^(MIPStarRE/|MIPStarRE\.lean|blueprint/src/|blueprint/lean_decls|scripts/(audit_new_proof_obligation_metadata|audit_paper_facing_proof_debt|audit_conclusion_shaped_hypotheses|audit_unfaithful_markers|audit_lean_axiom_declarations|check_blueprint_latex|check_paper_gap_note_style|check_statement_paper_origin|check_source_statement_changes|blueprint_lean_sync|lean_header_utils|tex_utils)\.py|docs/(CONTRIBUTING|project_conventions|anti_patterns|blueprint_style_guide|formalization-patterns|proof_frontier_review)\.md|docs/paper-gaps/|\.github/(actions|prompts|workflows)/|AGENTS\.md)'; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: no statement-integrity files staged."
  exit 0
fi

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking changed paper-gap note structure."
python3 scripts/check_paper_gap_note_style.py --root . --staged --ci

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking statement-like paper-origin citations."
python3 scripts/check_statement_paper_origin.py --root .

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking new proof-obligation metadata."
python3 scripts/audit_new_proof_obligation_metadata.py --root . --staged --ci

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking paper-facing proof-debt headers."
echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: do not close proof gaps by adding non-paper bridge/package hypotheses."
python3 scripts/audit_paper_facing_proof_debt.py --root . --ci

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking conclusion-shaped hypotheses."
python3 scripts/audit_conclusion_shaped_hypotheses.py --root . --ci

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking unfaithful-dependency markers."
python3 scripts/audit_unfaithful_markers.py --root . --ci

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking explicit LDT axiom declarations."
python3 scripts/audit_lean_axiom_declarations.py --root . --ci

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: ok."

SCRIPT_PATH="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/$(basename "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_PATH")"

STEP_NAMES="build blueprint-render paper-gaps blueprint-sync file-length proof-debt proof-evasion statement-origin"

# Step exit codes with a meaning beyond "the command failed".
EXIT_TOOL_MISSING=91

CACHE_ROOT="${MIPSTARRE_CACHE_ROOT:-$HOME/.cache/mipstarre-dev}"
FULL_BUILD_LOCK="${MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK:-$CACHE_ROOT/.full-build-lock}"
BUILD_LOCK_WAIT_S="${MIPSTARRE_CI_BUILD_LOCK_WAIT_S:-14400}"
BUILD_LOCK_STALE_S="${MIPSTARRE_FULL_BUILD_LOCK_STALE_S:-10800}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Utilities
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

info() { printf 'ci.sh: %s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf 'ci.sh: warning: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

die() {
  printf 'ci.sh: error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 2
}

iso_now() { date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z; }
epoch_now() { date +%s; }

# Git hooks and Lake disagree about GIT_DIR: a lake invocation that inherits
# the hook's git environment resolves nested package repositories against the
# wrong repo.  Same subshell trick as .githooks/pre-push:19-24.
run_outside_git_env() (
  for _name in $(git rev-parse --local-env-vars); do
    unset "$_name" || true
  done
  "$@"
)

# Locks are advisory mkdir-based lease directories, matching the hot-main
# writer lease convention in local/protocols/build-cache.md.
HELD_LOCKS=""

lock_age_s() {
  # $1 = lock dir.  Prints the age in seconds of its owner stamp, or a huge
  # number when the stamp is unreadable (treat as stale).

*) printf 'ERROR: no step body for %s\n' "$1"; return 2 ;;
  esac
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dispatch
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

FAILED=0
ERRORED=0
BUILD_OUTCOME=""
BUILD_SECONDS=0

for STEP in $STEP_NAMES; do
  LOG="$LOG_DIR/$STEP.log"

  if [ -n "$ONLY_STEPS" ]; then
    case " $ONLY_STEPS " in
      *" $STEP "*) ;;
      *)
        record_step "$STEP" skipped 0 "$LOG" 1 "not selected by --only"
        continue
        ;;
    esac
  fi

  if [ "$FORCE_ALL" != 1 ] && ! step_gate "$STEP"; then
    record_step "$STEP" skipped 0 "$LOG" 1 "no changes under $(step_gate_paths "$STEP")"
    printf '  %-18s skipped\n' "$STEP"
    continue
  fi

  if [ "$STEP" = build ] && [ "$SKIP_BUILD" = 1 ]; then
    record_step "$STEP" skipped 0 "$LOG" 1 "operator passed --skip-build"
    printf '  %-18s skipped (--skip-build)\n' "$STEP"
    continue
  fi

  : > "$LOG"
  _step_start="$(epoch_now)"

  # Invariant 7: at most one full lake build machine-wide.  Only the build
  # step compiles; the audits are pure Python and take no lock.
  _locked=1
  if [ "$STEP" = build ]; then
    if acquire_lock "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK" "$BUILD_LOCK_WAIT_S" "$BUILD_LOCK_STALE_S" "ci.sh pr=$PR_ID sha=$HEAD_SHA"; then
      _locked=0
    else
      _locked=2
    fi
  else
    _locked=0
  fi

  if [ "$_locked" = 2 ]; then
    {
      printf 'ERROR: could not take the machine-wide full-build lock %s within %ss.\n' "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK" "$BUILD_LOCK_WAIT_S"
      printf 'Another full build (warmer or another worktree) is running; it is never killed.\n'
    } >> "$LOG"
    _rc="$EXIT_TOOL_MISSING"
  else
    set +e
    # Required commands must stop the step; the parent still collects its exit
    # code, releases the build lock, and continues with independent steps.
    ( set -e; run_step_body "$STEP" ) >> "$LOG" 2>&1
    _rc=$?
    set -e
    if [ "$STEP" = build ]; then
      release_lock "$FULL_BUILD_LOCK"
    fi
  fi

  _elapsed=$(( $(epoch_now) - _step_start ))

  if [ "$_rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    _outcome=success
    _note=""
  elif [ "$_rc" -eq "$EXIT_TOOL_MISSING" ]; then
    _outcome=error
    _note="step could not run: $(grep -m1 '^ERROR:' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || echo 'missing tool or prerequisite')"
    ERRORED=1
  else
    _outcome=failure
    _note="exit $_rc"
    FAILED=1
  fi

 "body": "### Motivation\n- Fix #537: the default `MIPStarRE` build omitted the existing absorption and marginal-contraction point helpers. They support the projection and marginal estimates in `lem:qld-xz-lines`, paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:902-927`.\n\n### Description\n- Import `Points.MarginalContraction` from `Combining.Points`; it already imports `Points.Absorption`, which imports `Points.Closeness`. This preserves the existing point API and makes both helpers reachable from `MIPStarRE.QPBT` and the root target with one import substitution.\n- The root closure remains acyclic and now includes all modules under `Combining/Points/`. The separate orphan `Lines.PointwiseDefect` has no callers and is not required by this point import contract, so it remains outside this change. Proofs, signatures, citations, and workflow gates are unchanged.\n\n### Testing\n- Hook installation check, focused `lake env lean` checks of `Absorption.lean`, `MarginalContraction.lean`, and `Points.lean`, and `git diff --check` passed.\n- No `sorry`, `axiom`, `admit`, or kernel-bypass markers in these three files.\n- Exact-head CI and default-build artifact regeneration are pending publication; results will be recorded on this PR before independent review handoff.\n\n---\nCloses #537\n",
